question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multi item line'
  END AS order_type,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
  SUM(o.SALES_QTY) AS total_ordered_units,
  AVG(o.SALES_QTY) AS avg_ordered_units
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY order_type
ORDER BY 
  CASE order_type 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Multi item line' THEN 2
  END

action.metrics: order_count, total_ordered_units, avg_ordered_units, share of orders by type
action.group_by: order_type (No item line, One item line, Multi item line)
action.answer:
In 2025, among orders with item line data:

- Orders with more than one item line ("Multi item line") made up 3052089 out of (1307684 + 3052089 = 4359773) orders, or 70.025857% of orders.
- Orders with exactly one item line ("One item line") made up 1307684 orders, or 29.974143% of orders.
- No orders were found with zero item lines ("No item line"), as this category did not appear in the results.

Average ordered units per order:
- One item line: 1.219753 units/order
- Multi item line: 3.484769 units/order

Interpretation: The majority of 2025 orders (about 70%) contained more than one item line, and these multi-line orders had a much higher average number of units per order (3.484769) compared to single-line orders (1.219753). No orders were recorded with zero item lines in this period.
action.reason: All requested values are present in the query result. The share calculation is based on the total of one-line and multi-line orders, as no zero-line orders were found.
